§6Fluid Enricher§f

§aEnriches items with fluid additives.§f
The §bFluid Enricher§f takes §b1 item input§f and §b1 fluid input§f, producing §b1 fluid output§f. Default cycle is §b600 ticks§f at §b10 RF/t§f. It's used for enriching materials with fluid additives, creating enriched variants for advanced recipes.

You'll need this for some nuclear fuel processing and advanced material production chains. It's a niche machine but essential when you need it. The enriched fluids it produces are used in downstream processes.

§ePS:§f The Enricher loses progress on interruption. Buffer your inputs with tanks or ducts to prevent stalls in your processing line. Steady input means steady output.
